root_cause: export layout width and grouping mismatch
fix: treat metric row as atomic in export layer

root_cause: export layer not excluding interactive elements

symptom: outer area background incorrect vs design

symptom: all items show same label instead of first only
layout mismatch between UI and PDF

fix: retarget correct layer with precise prompt

symptom: Zoom flicker on transition, 1px border thickening to 2px, and initial fail to maximize in Focus Mode
root_cause: CSS Zoom scales borders, layout settling delay, and transition interference
fix: Implement non-scaling border (calc(1px/zoom)), zoom-pending visibility toggle, and re-render with settlement delay
avoid: Do not manually call fitting logic without double-rAF or settlement delay

issue: Legacy domain name remained across storage and UI layers
symptom: The interface represented a pharmacy but API and JSON still used a different business-domain key
root_cause: A UI-only rename preserved the old storage contract
fix: Rename the domain key consistently across API, JSON records, frontend state, reports, export and documentation
avoid: Do not rename only visible labels when a domain concept is shared across layers
regression_checks: reports and export load migrated data
legacy business name absent from tracked files

issue: Dashboard needed a mobile-friendly public mode behind reverse proxy
symptom: Desktop dashboard worked locally but there was no explicit mobile view switch and no lightweight health endpoint for NPM/service checks
root_cause: The UI only relied on responsive CSS and the app had no production-oriented runtime contract
fix: Add a persisted Desktop/Mobile view switch, render a card-based mobile list from the same data source, and expose /health with env-driven host/port/debug settings
avoid: Do not fork the data model or require a separate mobile app just to support phone usage
regression_checks: CRUD and exports still use the same records

issue: JSON-backed app needed a safe macOS service template
symptom: The app should run as a persistent Mac mini service behind Nginx Proxy Manager without exposing the app directly
root_cause: JSON file storage is fragile under concurrent workers and should be kept behind a single localhost-bound process
fix: Use launchd with a localhost bind, one gunicorn worker, and a documented env file so NPM can proxy to the service safely
avoid: Do not expose the app directly on the public network or add multiple workers while monthly data is still stored as JSON

issue: OCR chart labels were parsed correctly but preview showed inflated values
symptom: A 7-day pharmacy chart showed 10/07 as 1,672,000 in the app even though the image label was 376.0K
root_cause: Frontend preview could ignore backend value_labels and fall back to canvas bar-height estimation, which is unreliable for small K-labelled bars
fix: When OCR returns value_labels, build preview rows directly from those labels before using image bar detection fallback
avoid: Do not recalibrate or infer bar heights when explicit numeric labels are already available
regression_checks: unlabelled 30-day images still use bar detection fallback

issue: Unlabelled 30-day chart bars were assigned to the wrong calendar days
symptom: A 30-day pharmacy image assigned a tall ~1.6M bar to 10/07 even though 10/07 was a small bar
root_cause: Frontend mapped detected bars by sequential index, so missing or near-zero bars shifted later dates
fix: For unlabelled charts, assign day offsets from each bar's X position across the detected range_days instead of detected-bar order
avoid: Do not assume every date has a detectable colored bar in sparse charts
regression_checks: 7-day labelled charts still use OCR labels
zero or near-zero days do not shift following days

issue: Image import could overwrite manually entered revenue cells
symptom: Importing historical chart data risked replacing hand-entered June values in the same date and field
root_cause: Confirm import unconditionally assigned row.amount to the target field before saving
fix: Skip import rows when the existing target field already has a non-zero value and report imported/skipped counts
avoid: Do not treat image import as authoritative over manually entered data
regression_checks: other fields on the same day are preserved

issue: Mac reboot returned 502 because the app service was not registered for login startup
symptom: After the machine was powered off and opened again, Nginx/Cloudflare returned 502 and nothing listened on 192.168.1.88:5501
root_cause: The launchd plist existed only in the project deploy folder, not in ~/Library/LaunchAgents, so the user LaunchAgent was not bootstrapped after reboot
fix: Copy the plist to ~/Library/LaunchAgents, validate it, bootstrap it into the gui domain, enable it, and kickstart the service
avoid: Do not assume a plist in the repository is installed as a LaunchAgent

issue: Multiple local checkouts can make the active service run a stale repository path
symptom: The same GitHub repo exists in several local folders while LaunchAgent points to only one of them
root_cause: Git remote identity does not identify which local checkout should be used by launchd
fix: Compare remotes, commits, working trees, and the installed LaunchAgent before changing its WorkingDirectory or interpreter path
avoid: Do not retarget launchd based only on a guessed folder name; confirm the canonical local checkout first
regression_checks: selected checkout has the intended branch and commit
plist interpreter and WorkingDirectory point to the same checkout
launchctl print shows the expected path

issue: 30-day image import shifted dates when one low bar was not detected
symptom: Only CK thuốc missed 30/7 and all later imported values appeared under the wrong dates
root_cause: Frontend mapped detected bars by stretching the first-to-last detected range across all expected days, so a missing internal bar compressed the remaining date positions
fix: Estimate the slot width from the median measured center gaps and anchor detected bars from the final chart day
avoid: Do not infer a 30-day chart grid from first and last detected bars when low or zero bars can be omitted
regression_checks: 30-day image with one missing internal bar keeps later dates aligned
7-day charts with OCR value labels remain unchanged
preview dates are checked before confirmation
existing non-zero cells are not overwritten

issue: Image import needed a deliberate per-cell overwrite decision
symptom: Imported values could be compared only by relying on the previous skip behavior, without seeing the stored value beside the OCR value
root_cause: Preview rows contained only the proposed amount and had no loaded snapshot of the matching existing record
fix: Load existing monthly records into preview rows, show the current amount beside the OCR amount, and enable overwrite only for explicitly checked rows
avoid: Keep overwrite opt-in and preserve the existing-value safeguard for unchecked rows
regression_checks: preview shows existing values for all matching dates and fields
toast reports imported, overwritten, and skipped counts

issue: Partial OCR value labels shifted imported chart dates
symptom: CK thuốc could import values under the wrong days while other accounts were correct
root_cause: Any non-empty OCR label list was treated as complete, even when it contained fewer labels than the chart's stated range
fix: Use direct OCR labels only when their count equals the detected chart range; otherwise detect bars by chart position
avoid: Do not derive the import range from a partial label list
regression_checks: 7-day chart with all labels uses direct OCR amounts
7-day chart with a missing label keeps date positions from bar detection
